connection_providers.title: Git accounts — the repositories this deployment acts on
connection_providers.title_he: חשבונות Git — המאגרים שהלשכה פועלת בהם
connection_providers.now: Nothing to type here, and that is the point: a git account is an INSTANCE of `git_github_token`, `git_gitlab_token` or `git_forge_local` in the credential plane, created and removed from the version-control screen at /a/git/, and its token never leaves that vault. The `git_forge_local` instance is the office's OWN forge (Forgejo) — created by this app's bootstrap on enable, so a fresh deployment can create a local repository without anyone pasting a key. This row carries the PROTOCOLS, so the accounts are visible in this catalog and in the console's account bar. The probe is the app's own /healthz: the row is green exactly while the service that acts on those accounts is up.
connection_providers.wizard: the version-control screen connects an account in four steps: provider → how to connect → paste token → verify. The local forge needs no wizard: it is connected by the app itself.
